preparationNotes: High Attack funds finisher Verdict banking; dead swings trade delivery for vulnerability.
Role template swarm; 40/45 RP, 5 free. Defining offense and encounter support precede optional Expose.
Volcanic plating/hardening and active/kill Recovery; kills are required for the extra recovery window.
Base stance offensive-stance; one paid stance, no destinations or stance automation; no rites.
Inherited Find Enemies, telegraph escape, Avoid Hazards and Recover First; mid range Orbit uses Desert kiting boots.
No generic low-HP Flee and no Wait It Out.
One continuous life; 5/10/20 minute endpoints, first owner death stops.
Native default Technique priority unless the exact AoE Rune overrides it.
Unused RP 5 is below the next optional Expose cost or avoids redundant channel/mobility/cast tools; no budget filler or precharge.

limitations: Historical surviving loadout validated through prepareSurveyBot, then target biome reset to segment entry; mastery freeze removed
Mature gear and owned abilities retained: a conditional throughput screen, not an earned arrival journey
Native reference set costs are funding benchmarks, not the equipped mixed-biome set or actual purchases
No cross-biome routing or revivals; first death stops each run
